simulator.name: reactor
simulator.description: Isothermal batch reactor with consecutive first-order reactions A->B->C. Maximise yield of the intermediate B minus heating, catalyst and lost-throughput (time) costs. Higher temperature speeds both reactions but favours the unwanted B->C step (higher activation energy).

params.name: cat
params.description: catalyst loading (boosts A->B only, diminishing returns)

fidelities.name: euler_coarse
fidelities.notes: explicit Euler with 6 steps; biased, and numerically unstable when k*tau/6 > 2 (hot, long runs)

fidelities.name: bdf_fine
fidelities.notes: stiff BDF solver, rtol 1e-9; reference accuracy
